content:
The project delivery type that is concerned with all aspects of building performance while also needing to coordinate the different building systems to avoid rework is:

**A. integrated**

Integrated project delivery (IPD) emphasizes collaboration among all stakeholders and aims to optimize project outcomes by considering the entire project lifecycle. This type of delivery method seeks to minimize rework and enhance building performance through better coordination of different building systems.
